events.title: Demo is OUT !
events.summary: Hello fellow NANOTINKER. I’m very proud to give you access to the NANOTINKER DEMO ! It’s out now and shall be your first step into the mysterious world of Tim Tom, I.C.U. and a special mission that you will long remember!I really hope you will enjoy it as much as i like to share it with you. It’s your first step to grasp on the world and the gameplay! The demo is representing less than 3% of the final content of the game, mostly levels and mechanics wise. events.title: TRAILER AND NEWS
events.summary: First time writing here fellow Nanotinker. I’m very proud to be able to give you a glimpse of what will be in the game. I hope you enjoyed the trailer and it motivates you to learn more about the game as much as i like working on it. So far the developpement is coming good, there are still plenty of things to do but keeping the good pace. So far, so good !Please consider adding the game to your wishlist and follow the news as i’m going to report progress with Steam and giving you crispy insights
